messages:
eden: Planning a safemode cutover tomorrow 02:00 UTC - low-traffic window. Goal: add mv_last_seen_ts to tenant_views and refresh materialized views incrementally. Will pause CDC and downstream pipelines.
deploy-bot: :information_source: Scheduled deployment: release/2026.03.22 - holdpoint at 01:55 UTC. React with :thumbsup: to proceed.
frank: ack. I'll snapshot primary and promote a read replica snapshot for quick rollback if needed.
gina: request: pin migrator image to `migrator:2026-03-22-01` so we have deterministic retries.
harry: +1 for pin. also add a preflight checksum: `select md5(string_agg(id::text,',')) from tenant_views where tenant_id = $1`. Run for canary tenants before applying.
db-admin: adding kill-switch config: `select set_config('cutover.mode','safeguard',true);` workers poll this every 10s. Also prepare a `pg_cancel_backend(pid)` helper in the runbook.
infra-bot: Will mute downstream data-pump alerts and pause the CDC stream at 01:58 UTC. Posting links to pause script: https://internal/ops/pause-cdc.sh
eden: Cutover plan (timeline):
- 01:55 holdpoint (manual)
- 01:56 pause CDC & data-pump
- 01:57 run preflight checksum on 3 canary tenants
- 02:00 apply online DDL: add `mv_last_seen_ts` (nullable)
- 02:02 refresh MV for canaries (concurrent, rate-limited)
- 02:10 if canaries OK -> stagger remaining shards at 5m intervals
- Abort conditions: refresh lock wait > 1s consistently, replication lag > 45s, or >0.5% error rate in refresh jobs

frank: one thing -- (oops) ignore noise. Confirming snapshot pinned.
gina: pinned migrator image and toggled feature flag `mv_safe_refresh=true` for the canary.
harry: running preflight checksum for tenant 3: `md5=9f8a7b...` matches baseline. ready to proceed.
deploy-bot: :warning: Holdpoint reached. [Proceed] [Abort] buttons available.
eden: proceeding in 30s. please be ready to abort.
(30s later)
harry: Proceeded. deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary started, migrator pinned.
gina: canary mv refresh logs: `refreshed=4200 rows; locks=0.12s avg; errors=0`
db-admin: replicas: lag ~7s, CPU on writer node spiked 12% but stable.
infra-bot: CDC paused. data-pump queue depth at 0.
eden: kicking off staged refresh on next two shards. watching mgmt dashboard.
frank: noticing MV refresh for shard 7 slow on tenant 7-901: `lock wait 2.3s` and repeated `canceling statement` retries.
db-admin: canceling the offending backend and failing the job for tenant 7-901; marking tenant as deferred for offline backfill.
gina: updated release note draft: "Add mv_last_seen_ts to tenant_views; materialized view refresh runs online; one large tenant (7-901) deferred for manual offline refresh."
harry: observed replication lag spike to 52s briefly during the forced cancels. it's back to ~9s now. Keeping the abort threshold in mind.
eden: decision: continue with other shards but tighten guardrails - if replication lag >40s for >2m we'll abort.
frank: will rehydrate snapshot for tenant 7-901 later and run offline procedure. flagging as follow-up.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Staggered rollout completed for all batches except deferred tenants. No full rollback required.
db-admin: post-cutover action: re-enable CDC and run consistency checks for deferred tenants. Runbook updated: include `pg_cancel_backend` steps, and show how to flip `cutover.mode` to `abort`.
infra-bot: unmuting downstream alerts and resuming pipelines.
gina: pushing final release note to #release-notes.
eden: follow-ups: add heuristic to detect huge contiguous archival ranges and auto-defer, and add MV refresh timeout backoff. Scheduling postmortem ticket.
frank: metrics look stable after 25m. good job all. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
